# SkillUp Forever

Classic profession-levelling numbers inside WoW: Forever's Professions window.

[![CI](https://github.com/cjber/skillup-forever/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/cjber/skillup-forever/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/cjber/skillup-forever)](https://github.com/cjber/skillup-forever/releases/latest)
[![CurseForge downloads](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1705762?label=CurseForge%20downloads)](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/skillup-forever)

[![Sponsor me on GitHub](docs/github-sponsors-button.png)](https://github.com/sponsors/cjber) [![Support me on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/cjber)

SkillUp Forever shows skill-up chances, recipe costs and colour thresholds in the Professions window, with levelling routes, shopping lists, crafted gear and buffs in its side panel.

## Known limitations

- Recipe colours come from the game, but a recipe you have not seen yet uses bundled thresholds that can be slightly off.
- Trainer fees, requirements and drop chances come from Classic databases, as the game lists none until you visit.
- Gathering nodes and corpses have no colour in the game, so theirs is an estimate.
- Some Demonsage may show no required skill, as one of the two game objects with that name lists none.
- On non-English clients, herb and ore node tooltips may show no required skill, as the bundled node names are English.
- Prices need an auction scan or a price addon; until then, steps show a price unknown.
- Working Overtime's bonus (4% per rank, 20% at 5/5) is not confirmed as added points or a multiplier, so the estimate is off by default; turn on Include Working Overtime estimate to see the additive reading.
- With two professions tracked that share reagents, the shopping list can count the same bag items for both.

![Leatherworking levelling from 48 to 60 in the Professions window](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cjber/skillup-forever/main/docs/screenshots/demo.gif)

From 48 to 60 the rows re-sort by cost per skill-up, and Handstitched Leather Bracers turns green at 55.

![The Leatherworking window with skill-up chance and cost per skill-up on each recipe row, and a tooltip showing reagent prices and cost per skill-up](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cjber/skillup-forever/main/docs/screenshots/window.png)

Each row shows its chance and cost; the tooltip prices each reagent. This character skins, so Light Leather is valued at what selling it would bring.

![A recipe tooltip with the orange, yellow, green and grey thresholds on a bar, your skill marked, and each reagent's price and cost per skill-up](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cjber/skillup-forever/main/docs/screenshots/tooltip.png)

The tooltip draws the thresholds on the game's bar, then each reagent's price and the cost per skill-up.

## Features

- **Recipe rows and tooltips** show skill-up chance, cost, colour thresholds and how many your bags can make.
- **Sorting** orders recipes by difficulty range start, chance, cheapest skill-ups, highest craft profit or newest learned first; unlearned ones sort separately.
- **Unlearned recipes** can sit under the learned ones, greyed and marked with their trainer or recipe item, and the search box and *Has skill up* filter narrow them. Click one to preview its read-only details in the crafting pane.
- **Buffs only** filters the list to the buffs you can use at your level.
- **Levelling routes** list the crafts, trainer visits, skill books and rank quests to your target skill, in order, each with its amount and cost. [Route details](https://github.com/cjber/skillup-forever/blob/main/docs/route.md#levelling-route).
- **Shopping lists** count reagents against bags and bank and keep an Auctionator list current. At the auction house, click *Search* in the Professions window to find the reagents still needed for the crafts you choose. [Shopping details](https://github.com/cjber/skillup-forever/blob/main/docs/route.md#shopping-list).
- **Trainer annotations** show chance and cost, with a green arrow on the best recipe for your route.
- **Reagent tooltips**, on in settings, show what tracked routes need; Shift lists every recipe that uses the item, naming its profession. Herb and ore nodes show the skill they need, coloured at yours.
- **Crafted gear** shows the newest item you could craft for each slot, with its recipe and reagents. [Gear details](https://github.com/cjber/skillup-forever/blob/main/docs/gear.md).
- **Buffs** show what each profession can make for your level on a skill timeline. [Buffs details](https://github.com/cjber/skillup-forever/blob/main/docs/buffs.md).

![The SkillUp route tab: training and crafting steps from 48 to 73 with their costs, and the reagents they need](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cjber/skillup-forever/main/docs/screenshots/route.png)

The route from 48 to 73, in order, with each craft's amount, range and cost.

![The standalone SkillUp shopping list with source groups, missing counts and prices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cjber/skillup-forever/main/docs/screenshots/shopping-list.png)

The shopping list groups what is missing by source, with bag and alt holdings beside prices.

![The Crafted gear tab: item slots down both sides and along the bottom, each showing the newest crafted item, with one slot's recipe, reagents and status in the middle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cjber/skillup-forever/main/docs/screenshots/gear.png)

The gear tab, turned on in settings: each slot's newest craft for this character.

![The Buffs tab: the Cooking buff timeline scrolled to the next rank, with column skill numbers, the rank divider, the legend, and the selected buff's words, source and reagents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cjber/skillup-forever/main/docs/screenshots/buffs.png)

The buffs tab: each effect by the skill it is learned at, with the selected buff's source.

![The objective tracker with Leatherworking to 73, the next training step and the reagents still missing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cjber/skillup-forever/main/docs/screenshots/tracker.png)

Tracked, the route sits beside your quests: the next trainer visit and what is still missing.

![An Apprentice Leatherworking trainer's recipes, each with its skill-up chance and cost, and a green arrow on the vest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cjber/skillup-forever/main/docs/screenshots/trainer.png)

At the trainer, each recipe shows its chance and cost; a green arrow marks the best next one.

![Ruined Leather Scraps' tooltip with how much the tracked route needs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cjber/skillup-forever/main/docs/screenshots/reagent.png)

Hover a reagent to see how much your tracked routes need.

## Install

Install it from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/skillup-forever), or take the zip from [Releases](https://github.com/cjber/skillup-forever/releases) and extract it into the client's `Interface/AddOns/` folder (`_forever_` on the live client).

## Usage

Open a profession and the numbers are already there.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/skillup` | Open the settings (also in Settings → AddOns or the addon compartment) |
| `/skillup skipped` | List the recipes you said *Not this recipe* to, and `/skillup unskip <ID>` (or `all`) brings them back |
| `/skillup audit` | Compare the bundled thresholds with the colours the game shows |
| `/skillup report` | Show a report to copy into a bug report |
| `/skillup issue` | Open a ready-made GitHub issue link to report a bug or request a feature |
| `/skillup shopping`, `/skillup shop` | Open the shopping list, copy it, or plan a buy trip with Shortest Path Forever |
| `/skillup trainers` | List the trainer skill requirements SkillUp guessed, and which ones a trainer confirmed |

Settings cover rows and tooltips, prices, sort order, the tabs and trainer annotations. **Include Working Overtime estimate** starts off, so chances use the base formula. Crafted gear and reagent tooltips start off, each one setting away.

Enable **Show prices on crafted item tooltips** under **Tooltips and sorting** to compare the lowest known crafting cost per item with its latest Auctionator price after the auction house cut, including on item links in chat.

## Prices

Each reagent uses the cheapest known vendor or auction price, and visiting a vendor records its prices and reputation discounts. *Buy reagents* is on by default, so materials your professions gather are bought; choose gathering to supply them yourself. *Value gathered materials at what they'd sell for* is on for new installs and costs them at their sale value; turn it off to count them as free. *Price self-supplied reagents at auction values* prices what you gather, loot or own at market value, and leaves it unpriced when there is none.

Auction prices come from Auctionator's latest scan, TradeSkillMaster's AuctionDB with its desktop app, AHDB, Naowh Forever's scans and nightly auction data, or Forever Ledger's own scans. Naowh's snapshot can price materials before your first auction house visit. *Auction prices from* picks which source wins, and the others fill the gaps. SkillUp starts an Auctionator search when you click *Search* in the Professions window. Prices stay unknown until a price source records them.

A craft's vendor sell value comes off its cost, or its auction value after the 5% cut if you choose. *Region sale average if higher* uses regional sales with the vendor price as a floor, and recipe tooltips add TSM's regional sales per day where it has them. Profit shows a green `+`, and cost per skill-up divides net cost by chance.

## How the numbers work

Each recipe has four thresholds: orange (start of its skill range), yellow, green and grey. Chance follows the Classic formula:

| Colour | Chance |
|---|---|
| Orange | 100% |
| Yellow, green | `(grey − skill) / (grey − yellow)` |
| Grey, or at your skill cap | 0% |

The colour comes from the game, the grey band uses its live value where the client reports one, and missing or contradictory ranges show `?`.

**Found a wrong number?** Run `/skillup report` in that profession and paste it into a [Wrong number issue](https://github.com/cjber/skillup-forever/issues/new?template=wrong_number.yml).

## Works alongside

All optional: Auctionator, TradeSkillMaster, AHDB, Naowh Forever and Forever Ledger supply auction prices; Auctionator also takes the shopping list, TomTom draws waypoint arrows, and Syndicator shows your alts' reagents. [Questie](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/questie) names the vendors, quests and trainers the route points to, and [AtlasLoot Classic Forever](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/atlasloot-forever) names the scroll that teaches each recipe.

## The Forever addons

Each one works on its own, and they work together when you install more than one.

| Addon | What it does | Issues |
|---|---|---|
| [Shortest Path Forever](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/shortest-path-forever) | Plans journeys on foot, by air, by sea and through portals, with directions in the tracker. | [Issues](https://github.com/cjber/shortest-path-forever/issues) |
| [Adventure Guide Forever](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/adventure-guide-forever) | Suggests quests for your level and routes you from one to the next. | [Issues](https://github.com/cjber/adventure-guide-forever/issues) |
| [SkillUp Forever](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/skillup-forever) | Shows skill-up chances, recipe costs and levelling routes in the Professions window. | [Issues](https://github.com/cjber/skillup-forever/issues) |
| [Legacy Forever](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/legacy-forever) | Shows your unfinished Legacy challenges on the world map and tracks the ones you choose. | [Issues](https://github.com/cjber/legacy-forever/issues) |
| [Tweaks Forever](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/tweaks-forever) | Adds quest automation, rare alerts and merchant options to the game's settings. | [Issues](https://github.com/cjber/tweaks-forever/issues) |
| [Field Guide Forever](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/field-guide-forever) | Keeps a cosmetic journal of the creatures you kill, zone by zone. | [Issues](https://github.com/cjber/field-guide-forever/issues) |
| [Commissions Forever](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/commissions-forever) | Lists your commission turn-ins, the materials in your bags and the next NPC to visit. | [Issues](https://github.com/cjber/commissions-forever/issues) |
| [Macro Assist Forever](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/macro-assist-forever) | Adds a macro window with every macro in one list, a mono editor with live checks, and history. | [Issues](https://github.com/cjber/macro-assist-forever/issues) |

Bug reports, feature requests and pull requests are welcome on each addon's GitHub. Everyone whose report or idea ships is thanked by name on the Thanks page in game, in the store page and in the changelog, unless they ask not to be.

For help, ideas and each day's release notes, join [cjber's Workshop on Discord](https://discord.gg/FpHugGxRJY).

With [Shortest Path Forever](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/shortest-path-forever), clicking a trainer or vendor in the route plans the trip there, and SkillUp picks the nearest one by travel time. [Adventure Guide Forever](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/adventure-guide-forever) shows each profession's next steps in its Professions tab. A tracked route shares one tracker column with the Shortest Path, Adventure Guide and Legacy Forever sections, beside the game's quest tracker.

## Development

Link the checkout into the game (`ln -s "$PWD" ".../Interface/AddOns/SkillUpForever"`) and run the gate under [Commands in AGENTS.md](https://github.com/cjber/skillup-forever/blob/main/AGENTS.md#commands). CI runs the same gate plus actionlint, zizmor, gitleaks and the project rules; [tools/README.md](https://github.com/cjber/skillup-forever/blob/main/tools/README.md) covers the data generators.

**Releasing:** follow the [release skill](https://github.com/cjber/skillup-forever/blob/main/.agents/skills/release/SKILL.md); the BigWigs packager publishes each version's changelog entry to GitHub, CurseForge.

**Translating:** German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Korean and Chinese, machine translated; corrections welcome through the [translation form](https://github.com/cjber/skillup-forever/issues/new?template=translation.yml).

**Contributing:** read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/cjber/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/cjber/skillup-forever/blob/main/AGENTS.md) first. Report security problems privately, as [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/cjber/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md) describes.

## Support

The addon is free and stays GPL-3.0. If it saves you time, you can [sponsor me on GitHub](https://github.com/sponsors/cjber) or [buy me a coffee on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/cjber).

releases.notes:
### Fixed

- **Price, bag and zone changes no longer plan routes through Shortest Path.** With reagents that vendors sell only a few at a time, logging in and each of those changes asked Shortest Path for travel times to their vendors, and the game could freeze or stop with "script ran too long". The shopping list now takes the limit from the nearest of those vendors in a straight line, and the Gear and Buffs pages work out travel times when you click. Thanks to ZMasterKing and alexaroth for the freeze reports.
- **Showing where a reagent comes from no longer replans every profession.** The first time a tooltip, a tracker line or a click named where an item is sold or drops, the game could freeze for seconds. Only the lines that name those places redraw now. Thanks to ZMasterKing and sirbobbydanger for the freeze reports.

### Changed

- Ships with the same shared code as your other Forever addons, so they keep working together.
- The Thanks page lists more players. More of the people whose reports and ideas shipped are now thanked by name in game.

### Fixed

- Demonsage and Heavy Thorium Vein tooltips show the skill they need, and Demonsage and Heavy Thorium Ore count as materials a Herbalist or Miner can gather.

### Fixed

- Profession routes and recipe suggestions only recommend lessons and patterns your specialisation can learn. Thanks to user_p89ptupzfjx58rsj for the report.

- Ships with the same shared code as your other Forever addons, so they keep working together.
- Recipe data matches game build 1.60.1.71139: one more Centaur Hoofwarmers recipe, Boiled Clams, Clam Chowder, Undermine Clam Chowder and Clam Linguine on the Buffs page, and the current vendor sell prices.

### Added

- Turn on **Show prices on crafted item tooltips** to compare crafting cost with the latest Auctionator sale estimate on the item itself, including chat links. Thanks to Bogdanov89 for the request.
- **Window scale makes SkillUp's side windows readable.** Use it in SkillUp Forever’s **Route and trainer** settings to resize the Shopping list and its copy window, and make reagent text easier to read on SkillUp profession pages. Thanks to user_oin05iu5ioauw23u for the report.

### Changed

- Ships with the same shared code as your other Forever addons, so they keep working together.

### Fixed

- With QuestieDB installed, Alliance routes no longer plan trainer lessons for Troll's Blood Elixir or Barbecued Buzzard Wing, whose only listed trainers are Horde. The learn source names the recipe item, and the route includes it only when it can be bought. Thanks to user_46x8szwptrswqttc for the report about Troll's Blood Elixir.
- Copper Chain Pants now requires skill 15 and Coarse Grinding Stone requires skill 50 to learn from a trainer, matching the trainer window.
- The vendor's Reagents tab tells you to buy the listed items on the Merchant tab. The list fits widened vendor windows and keeps their extra items out of view while Reagents is open. Thanks to xh43k on CurseForge for the report.
- Levelling routes keep a recipe's level requirement when a saved trainer visit lacks a level, and drop a planned lesson if a trainer reveals that you are too low to learn it. Thanks to cursebandit on CurseForge for reporting a Leatherworking trainer stop.
